reviewScope.method: Exact actual PNG/source comparison of all six paragraphs, all terms/activity and ten proposed source occurrences. Search all canonical lesson paragraphs for selective/nonselective, foliar/soil treatment, dedicated nozzle/cover, herbicide, drift, phytotoxicity and weed-host concepts; read all returned paragraphs and complete six directly related baseline lessons. Inspect all resolution-target status/page/meaning against frozen backlog and overlays11/12. No full semantic reread of every unmatched paragraph or current product/legal verification claimed.

paragraphFindings.reason: PDF46 links weed habitat to healthy robust crops, quality and stable harvest. Baseline weeds lesson did not teach this host relationship.
PDF46 gives both impact-scope definitions. The attributed framing plus separate product-use qualification avoids treating selective as universal crop safety.
PDF46 directly supports stem/leaf absorption. Classification-axis comparison is a useful pedagogical explanation distinct from baseline label-method mention.
PDF46 supports residual soil location, emergence/growth inhibition and reduced effect on already large weeds; no unsupported root-absorption mechanism is added.
PDF47 prohibits dual use and PDF49 explains previous-chemical residue and phytotoxicity. Baseline general washing does not teach the equipment-separation reason.
PDF47/49 give dedicated nozzle/cover drift-prevention purpose near other crops. Distinguishing internal residue from external drift does not certify part performance or current product instructions.
